programme.title: IFISH: Barramundi, Horizontal Falls, WA
programme.desc: There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it! Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programme.title: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programme.desc: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1
programme.desc: Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 2
programme.desc: Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 4
programme.desc: The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 5
programme.desc: Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 6
programme.desc: Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.

programme.title: Boomerang: Don't Wanna Love You
programme.desc: En influencers magt bliver udforsket, da Tia får et højt betalt gig en aften på en stripklub, mens David bliver stærkt inspireret af en ny megakirke.

programme.title: Boomerang: Reversal Of a Dog
programme.desc: Bryson kunne ikke få den op at stå og overskrider alle grænser, da han taler om det hos frisøren. Ari tænker over begrænsningerne ved hans seksualitet og maskulinitet og udfordrer sin selvopfattelse.

programme.title: Boomerang: Day Weekend
programme.desc: Simone samler slænget og deres partnere i hendes fars lækre strandvilla. Det, der skulle føre alle sammen, ender med at belyse, hvor meget alle har forandret sig og er vokset fra hinanden.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: No Eggspectations
programme.desc: Kara foreslår et live-indslag i 'Talk Back', men hverken hun eller Mary Jane er forberedt på den nyhed, som dr. Marrs kommer med. Cameron og Niecy drøfter hans nye plads i hendes liv.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Pulling The Trigger
programme.desc: Mary Janes hormoner går helt grassat, da hun indleder fertilitetsbehandlinger. Hun bliver også tilbudt en eksklusiv historie af Sheldon DeWitt, som forværrer hendes forhold til Lisa.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Let's Go Crazy
programme.desc: Mary Jane bliver knust, da hun hører, at et af hendes interviews fik personen til at begå selvmord. SNC suspenderer Talk Back og bringer Mark i en ubekvem position.

programme.title: Twenties: The Pilot
programme.desc: Den spirende manuskriptforfatter Hattie bliver sat på gaden, bliver arbejdsløs og er bare uheldig, før hun møder den berømte forfatter/producer Ida B., hvis program, Cocoa's Butter, Hattie har kritiseret på sociale medier.

programme.title: Twenties: I've Got The World On A String
programme.desc: Hattie navigerer kontorpolitikken den første dag på sit nye job. Marie bliver plaget af sin spillegale mor, mens Nia tager chancen med en date med sin yogaklient.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 6
programme.desc: Top Gear prøver at takle vintervejret ved at kombinere en mejetærsker, lidt ingeniørsnilde og en tur til Norge.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 7
programme.desc: Richard opfylder en barndomsdrøm og prøvekører to superbiler fra 80'erne. James prøvekører NASA's seneste rumudforskningskøretøj.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 1
programme.desc: Jeremy holder 50-års jubilæum for den legendariske Jaguar E-type, og James kører om kap med en OL-guldmedaljevinder i maskotter.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 2
programme.desc: Jeremy, Richard og James tager til Italien til en række udfordringer og højrøstede skænderier for at se, hvad der er verdens bedste hatchback.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Blomsterviden

programme.title: Melrose Place: Lexi får den kolde skulder
programme.desc: Efter hendes færdige film til Marlin bliver destrueret, beslutter Amanda sig for at lukke sin virksomhed.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Døde mænd klapper ikke i
programme.desc: Da Marlin ved et uheld dør af en overdosis af Viagra, beder Lexi Michael om at hjælpe hende med at få Marlins livløse krop tilbage til huset.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Med kurs mod graven

programme.title: Wildfire: The Friend
programme.desc: Juniors optagethed af hans og Calvins forretningsforslag stjæler tid fra hans bryllupsplaner, men Laura har mistanke om, at hans tab af fokus kan have noget med Kris at gøre.

programme.title: Wildfire: Friendship/Passion
programme.desc: Junior er presset til at beslutte, om han vil gennemføre sit bryllup med Laura eller ej, efter at han og Kris deler et øjebliks lidenskab.

programme.desc: Da det ser ud til, at Flame er klar til sit første løb, beslutter Kris sig for at kæmpe for at få sit jockeycertifikat tilbage.

programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Haunts Me
programme.desc: A young mother-to-be is shot and left for dead. To catch her assailant, Kenda must elicit a death-bed confession from the victim herself.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Joker In the Pack
programme.desc: A card game is interrupted by gunfire, leaving a young man dead. Lt. Joe Kenda soon learns the seeds of his destruction were sewn earlier the same day.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Poker Face
programme.desc: A group of friends discover the corpse of entrepreneur Jamie Foster hidden under a blanket. Kenda e discovers that Foster’s business put him in close quarters with a host of unsavory characters.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Winter’s Bone

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Animal Nature
programme.desc: When a young woman is found mysteriously slaughtered on the steps of a trailer, Kenda and the homicide team must track down the vile perpetrators that are responsible

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Borderland / Mars: Red Dawn
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Shooting Gallery: Asteroids and Comets / Galactic Visions: Alien Worlds
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Gas Giants
programme.desc: In the cold, dark expanse of our solar system, beyond the asteroid belt, lie the giant planets. Some can be seen with the naked eye, others have been visited by our camera. What secrets do they hold?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire

programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This episode of Unplugged features Canadian star Alanis Morissette, shot from the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Alicia Keys MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Alicia Keys performs Unplugged at the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Placebo unplugged.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This highly-anticipated episode of MTV Unplugged features Lady Gaga and Tony Bennett performing a combination of stripped-back duets and solo songs from their Grammy-nominated album, Love For Sale.

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: MTV Unplugged,' world premiered this one hour performance with the legendary Paul McCartney. This performance was simulcast via the Global Satellite Network. Taped on January 25, 1991 at the Limehouse Studios in London.

programme.title: The Roast of Flavor Flav
programme.desc: I hver udgave af 'The Roast of' bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Det er Flavor Flavs tur til at sætte sig i kendissernes varme stol i det nyeste afsnit af The Comedy Central Roast.

programme.title: Another Period: Servant's Disease
programme.desc: En smitsom sygdom spredes blandt tjenestefolkene, og Lilian ender i karantæne med de syge. Beatrice og Frederick går på dobbeltdate, og Victor og Albert skændes over deres barbershop quartet.

programme.title: Another Period: Harvard
programme.desc: Albert Einstein besøger Ballacourt Manor, og Beatrice hjælper ham med at løse en svær ligning. Lillian prøver at skaffe et kondom, så hun kan have sex for nydelse, og Peepers finder Blanches 'fyr' på tosseanstalten.

programme.title: Another Period: Joplin
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrice prøver at skrive et hit med hjælp fra en Kanye-agtig sangskriver ved navn Joplin. Peepers kæmper med sine nyligt opdagede kødelige lyster.

programme.title: Another Period: Tubman
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrice møder Harriet Tubman, der fortæller dem, hvordan de skaber et 'brand' til sig selv og bliver berømte. Imens ansætter Peepers en ny tjener, og Chair føder baby Kermit.

programme.title: Workaholics: Checkpoint Gnarly
programme.desc: Alices bror kommer på forretningsrejse. Anders, Adam og Blake tager ham ud i byen en aften. Det går galt, når de bliver tjekket for sprutkørsel.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Strike
programme.desc: Anders, Adam og Blake beslutter, at de vil have en fridag for at fejre helligdagen 'halvt jul'. Når Alice nægter, strejker de.

programme.title: Workaholics: Muscle I'd Like to Flex
programme.desc: Fyrene øver sig på deres troldmands-rap til renæssaincemarkedet. Adam falder for en ældre kvinde, som han møder, mens han træner på kontorets tag. Anders og Blake føler sig uden for.

programme.title: Workaholics: In the Line of Getting Fired
programme.desc: Adam, Anders og Blake må kæmpe for deres job, når TelAmeriCorps direktør, Bruce Benson, beslutter at likvidere firmaet. Benson har en meget mærkelig anmodning.

programme.desc: Efter Sam pludselig bliver tvunget i fængsel, lover Carly og Freddie ikke at aflyse netshowet, fordi hendes far skal se det. Hun beder Spencer om hjælp, men det bliver svært, for han skal på date.

programme.title: iCarly: Rumvanvid
programme.desc: En pudsig milliardær beder Carly og hendes venner om at sende det første netshow fra rummet, så de bliver testet til en rumrejse. Imens besøger en mærkelig lille pige Spencer.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie flytter hjemmefra
programme.desc: Freddie beslutter at flytte ud af sin lejlighed efter hans mor gør ham flov. Carly, Sam og Freddie starter et firma, specialiserer sig i fotos af kæledyr.

programme.title: iCarly: Lejlighedsvisit
programme.desc: Da en hedebølge rammer Seattle og strømmen går, kommer Spencer til undsætning med et norsk klimaanlæg.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-brølere
programme.desc: De medvirkende introducerer bloopers og smuttere fra serien.

programme.title: iCarly: iFik et varmt rum
programme.desc: Spencer forsøger at overraske Carly til hendes fødselsdag, men ender med at brænde hendes værelse ned. Men da forsikringen giver ham en stor check, får han mulighed for at gøre det godt igen.

programme.title: iCarly: iGør
programme.desc: Da en iCarly-fan frier til sin kæreste live i webshowet, bliver vennerne shanghajet til at komme til brylluppet. Men da bruden får kolde fødder, må Carly klarer ærterne.

programme.title: iCarly: iSælger penny-t-shirts
programme.desc: Vennerne kaster sig ud i at lave og sælge Penny-T-shits. Da salget går amok, hyrer Sam børn fra 4. til at hjælpe med at lave T-shirts. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie er uenige om, hvordan de skal behandles.

programme.title: iCarly: iLaver drengestreger
programme.desc: Da de andre driller Carly med, at hun aldrig har lavet fis, beder hun Spencer om hjælp med at lave fis med Sam og Freddie. Men da Spencer får smag for det, kan han ikke stoppe igen. Vennerne må finde en måde at stoppe ham på.

programme.title: iCarly: iSams mor
programme.desc: Efter et skænderi med sin mor flytter Sam ind hos Carly, som snart indser, at hun er en forfærdelig gæst. Freddie forfølges af en farlig forbryder, da han har fanget ham på fersk gerning på video.

programme.title: iCarly: iSkam på Nevel
programme.desc: Da en video af Nevel, der råber ad en lille pige, dukker op på nettet, begynder alle at hade ham. Efter de har fejret Nevels fald, går iCarly-vennerne i gang med at genoprette hans ære, da han tigger om deres hjælp.
